$comment: Advisories the weekly audit accepts on purpose. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs; policy in docs/decisions/0016-audit-allowlist-with-expiry.md. Each entry is one GHSA on one package, with a reason and an expiry. When it expires the audit goes red: check for a fix, then renew deliberately or remove.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces exists (every version flagged; latest 3.0.3 from 2024). Dev-only: eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces, globbing our own lint patterns, so the stack-exhaustion DoS needs attacker-controlled glob input we never take. npm's only 'fix' downgrades eslint-config-next to 14.x.
